t: AWS Private CA now provides detailed certificate issuance logs
x: New CloudTrail event with full certificate content, issuing CA, requester and status for every issuance, failed ones included.

t: AWS Client VPN now supports device posture assessment
x: CrowdStrike, Jamf or JumpCloud signals evaluated with Cedar policies; non-compliant sessions disconnected; monitoring-only mode.

t: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now supports continuous penetration testing integrated directly into your CI/CD pipeline
x: Public preview: pentest at deploy time, findings in pipeline output, fixes re-tested automatically.

t: AWS Control Tower AFT now supports plan-only customization runs
x: Run a Terraform plan for global and account customizations without applying changes.

t: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store
x: Restrict the Identity Store API to VPC endpoints, source VPCs or IP ranges, and the SCIM API to IP ranges. Off by default.

t: AWS Certificate Manager now supports ACME issuance through AWS PrivateLink
x: Request and renew public TLS certificates over a VPC interface endpoint, with no ACME client changes.

t: AWS Config now supports 77 new resource types
x: 77 resource types added, including Identity Center applications and GuardDuty entity sets; tracked automatically when recording all types.

t: Amazon GuardDuty RDS Protection now detects data exfiltration and destruction in Aurora and RDS databases
x: Query-pattern anomaly detection for Aurora PostgreSQL and RDS for PostgreSQL, no agents; 30-day free trial.

t: AWS Network Firewall adds wildcard support for container attribute filters
x: Wildcard patterns such as app=payments-* match every variant of an EKS or ECS workload in one rule.

t: AWS Lambda supports OAuth authentication for self-managed Apache Kafka event sources
x: Kafka event source mappings authenticate through an enterprise identity provider such as Cognito or Okta.

t: AWS Security Hub now exports findings to S3 in CSV or JSON format
x: On-demand export from every findings page to your S3 bucket, in CSV or OCSF JSON.
